metadata_source: Ethiopia Cholera Outbreak Flash Update 8 June 2023 OCHA
issue: cited source is dated to a single day but this row covers a full year; a dated bulletin cannot substantiate an annual total
action_required: verify against the source which entry actually supports this row, then correct source_index or source - do not simply relabel
resolution: RESOLVED BY AGENT 5, 2026-09-20. Verdict: the citation could not be made correct, so the row was retracted and replaced rather than relabelled. Index 30 asserted 'approximately 30,000 cholera cases with a CFR of nearly 1.4%' for calendar 2023 and cited metadata Index 12 (OCHA Flash Update, 8 June 2023); a single-day bulletin cannot substantiate an annual total, and the row's source LABEL did not match metadata Index 12's Source string either. What actually supports the 2023 annual figure: EPHI Bacterial Disease Surveillance and Response Weekly SITREP Ethiopia Vol #226, 26 Dec 2023, epi-week 52 (metadata Index 22), table 'Cholera Epidemiology since January 1, 2023', national Total = 29,487 cases / 422 deaths / CFR 1.43%. PDF retrieved this run from https://ephi.gov.et/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/National-Cholera-Daily-Update-226.pdf and read with pdftotext -layout. Decisive arithmetic: the eleven regional 2023 rows ALREADY in data/ETH/cholera_data_ai.csv from this same SITREP (Index 45-55) sum to exactly 29,487 cases and exactly 422 deaths. ACTION TAKEN: Index 30 retracted with a full tombstone in data/ETH/retracted_rows_ai.csv; replaced by Index 489 (AFR::ETH, 2023-01-01..2023-12-26, sCh 29,487, deaths 422, CFR 1.43, confidence 0.95, source_index 22, verbatim table quote). The rounded 30,000 was most likely a restatement of the SITREP's OTHER headline, the since-27-Aug-2022 cumulative of 30,334 cases / 449 deaths, which includes 851 cases from 2022. Metadata Index 12 remains Active and is still cited by other rows that it genuinely supports.
